Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::createSupplier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		sById: Set(Supplier) = Supplier.allInstance()->select(s: Supplier|s.Id = id),
		hasExisting: Boolean = sById.notEmpty()
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		Supplier.allInstance()->isUnique(s: Supplier|s.Id)
	postcondition:
		if hasExisting 
		then result = true 
		else let newSupplier: Supplier in
		newSupplier.oclIsNew() and
		Supplier.allInstance()->includes(newSupplier) and
		newSupplier.Id = id and
		newSupplier.Name = name and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
